say:1:1035728001:1.text: You don't seem like a goodie two-shoes, so I guess I can tell you.
say:1:1035728001:1.source_cn: 看你也不是啥正经人，偷偷给你透露一点。
say:1:1035728001:1.male: You don't seem like a goodie two-shoes, so I guess I can tell you.
say:1:1035728001:1.female: You don't seem like a goodie two-shoes, so I guess I can tell you.

say:2:1035728002:0.text: This place is close to Syndicate turf. Every now and then, a few golems wander around the area.
say:2:1035728002:0.source_cn: 这地方靠近黑金商会的地盘，他们那时不时会走几个魔偶出来。

say:3:1035728003:1.text: But as long as I don't attack them, they don't attack me.
say:3:1035728003:1.source_cn: 只要不去招惹它们，这帮魔偶也不来攻击咱。

say:4:1035728004:0.text: So I've been stealing their parts and selling them to the Conservatory for cash!
say:4:1035728004:0.source_cn: 偷偷拆点零件下来，就能去找冬青学会卖个好价钱。
